help.title: How to add a sticker
help.body: Pick a photo, confirm where the sticker is and choose its type. If the photo has a location the pin is already in place. If not, search for the place, paste a link or drag the pin.

draft.restored: We recovered a sticker that never got sent.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: Optional, but no photo means no glory.
photo.rotateFailed: We could not rotate the photo. Try again.
photo.undecoded: Your browser cannot shrink this photo. We send it as it is and an admin reviews it.

error.bad_type: That file is not a photo we can use. Pick a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
error.too_big: That photo is over 25 MB. Pick a lighter one.
error.unreadable: We could not read that photo. Try another or continue without a photo.

dup.title: This photo is already on the map
dup.body: Is it another sticker in the same photo?
dup.addHere: Add a sticker to that spot
dup.addTitle: Add a sticker to that spot
dup.addBody: Pick which sticker it is and who stuck it.
dup.added: Done, we added the sticker to that spot.
dup.gone: That spot is no longer on the map. Send it as a new sticker.

location.title: Location
location.error: Mark where the sticker is: search for the place, paste a link or tap the map.
location.pinLabel: Sticker pin. Use the arrow keys to nudge it.
location.dragHint: Drag the pin or tap the map
location.noBasemap: No basemap. You can still search or paste a link.
location.deviceFailed: We could not tell where you are. Search for the place or paste a link.
location.deviceFailedAuto: We could not tell where you are. Mark the place on the map.
location.searchFailed: We could not search right now. Paste a link or tap the map.

gestures.desktop: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
gestures.mobile: Use two fingers to move the map

paste.empty: Paste a Google Maps or Apple Maps link, or the coordinates.
paste.invalid: We found no coordinates there. Try “-34.9, -56.16” or a Google Maps link.
paste.out_of_range: Those coordinates do not exist: latitude goes from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180.
paste.short_link: That short link carries no coordinates. Open it and paste the long link, or the coordinates.

what.title: Which sticker?
what.typeError: Pick at least one sticker type.
what.notePlaceholder: E.g. above the hand dryer, next to the mirror.

error.network: The connection dropped. Your sticker is still here.
error.rate_limited: You sent a lot of stickers in a row. Your sticker is still here: wait a bit and retry.
error.turnstile: We could not verify you are a person. Your sticker is still here: retry.
error.too_large: The photo is too heavy. Pick a lighter one.
error.bad_image: That photo format cannot be uploaded. Try a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
error.exists: This photo is already on the map.
error.invalid: Something you entered is not valid. Check the details and retry.
error.server: Something failed on our side. Your sticker is still here: retry in a while.

thanks.shareText: Look at the sticker I added to Mapa Papin

edit.title: Edit sticker
edit.nothing: You have not changed anything yet.
edit.confirmBody: It leaves the map and the rankings. There is no undo.
edit.expired: The 24 h to edit this sticker are over.
edit.photoLocked: The photo cannot be changed. If you got it wrong, delete the sticker and send a new one.
edit.pinHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it.
edit.approxHint: Shown rounded (~100 m). Handy for homes.
edit.helpBody: You can change the type, who stuck it, the note and the place for 24 h, only from the device you sent it from.
edit.missingBody: It may have been deleted already.
edit.offlineTitle: We could not load the sticker
edit.noGrantTitle: This sticker cannot be edited from here
edit.noGrantBody: It can only be edited from the device it was sent from, for 24 h.

error.forbidden: The 24 h are over or this sticker was sent from another device, so you cannot change it.
error.invalid: Something you changed is not valid. Check it and retry.
error.server: Something failed on our side. Retry in a while.

common.thanksLine: Your Papin contribution is recognised and appreciated
